messages:
Elena: quick postmortem follow-up on the noise sweep 1: I mapped recurring pages -> proposing small set of surgical changes. attaching action list. link: https://internal.redwood/pm/noise-map :pushpin:
Raj: thanks. curious on how we measure regressions after suppression changes? we should quantify missed-alert risk.
Elena: agreed. success criteria: top-8 rule duplicate pages down 50% in 14d and estimated missed-alerts < 1% over the same window.
Tom: I'll own the gateway-rule dedupe canary. plan: 1) apply dedupe group_by=route for 2 regions low-traffic 2) monitor suppression_rate + missed_alert_estimate 3) roll forward. ETA: canary by Fri.
Raj: I'll handle DB auth timeouts. proposal: raise threshold to 99th pctl with 3m rolling window + add hysteresis so we don't page on short bursts.
Elena: for model-serving OOMs: short-term mem cushion + targeted soft-oom alerts (non-pager) to collect signals. longer term: rate-limit by model consumer.
Tom: sample dedupe snippet I tested locally:
```
policy: dedupe-v3
group_by: route.path_prefix
window: 180s
max_pages: 1
allow_urgent_if: error_rate > 0.2
```
Tom: will push as a canary to canary1 then post logs.
infra-bot: Created task INF-4980 assigned to Tom -> "gateway dedupe canary" due 2026-04-08.
Raj: we also need an observability guard: if `suppression_rate > 0.85 for 30m` -> open incident channel and auto-rollback canary.
Elena: add a Slack webhook and dashboard tile for suppression_rate and missed_alert_estimate. both visible before canary promotion.
Tom: added dashboard link to the action sheet. will post canary playback in ~2h.
Raj: paging policy tweak suggestion: Critical -> immediate escalate if no ack in 5m (2 pings), High -> single page then 20m suppression for duplicates, Medium -> no pager, only channel. include service-owner notification on suppression.
Elena: please include rollback playbook step: "if missed_alert_estimate > 0.01 for 1h -> rollback and notify infra oncall".
ops-bot: Linked postmortem PM-2026-03 to INF-4980, INF-4981.
Tom: timeline recap: Tom (gateway dedupe) canary Fri; Raj (auth thresholds) PR by Thu; Elena (dashboards + runbook) updates by Wed next week. weekly follow-up: Tue 10:30 30m.
Raj: small ask: add a recurring "brief noise triage" for 15m after weekly oncall handoff to keep drift minimal.
Elena: done, calendar invite created and shared board.
Tom: canary started on canary1. initial suppression_rate=0.39, missed_alert_estimate=0.002. will run synthetic churn and report.
Elena: great. I'll update the postmortem action sheet with owners, deadlines, rollback criteria and links. ping me if any blockers. :white_check_mark:
